goal: Define the executable Phase 1 development contract for the minimal product shell.
acceptance: Technology baseline and testing tools are explicit.
Phase 1 scope and manual approval gate are explicit.
Authority, security, UI, and CI/CD boundaries are documented.
verified: Phase 1 plan documents scope, exclusions, milestones, and completion evidence.
Harness rules define type, unit, build, interaction, and manual approval gates.
next_step: Start Phase 1 foundation: scaffold Electron, React, and TypeScript tooling with an acceptance checklist.
progress_commit_policy: Commit and push each appropriately sized, coherent, independently verifiable milestone to origin; do not commit every small edit.
